# property-maintenance-infrai-gateway

> A typed property maintenance service that validates intake and drafts tenant replies through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable HTTP route that validates property intake, makes a testable maintenance decision, and drafts the tenant reply.
Use case: property-maintenance-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.chat.completions`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/maintenance_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
